settings.cleanup.title: Cleanup and removal
settings.cleanup.clear_history_hint: Strategy search results, statistics and logs. My sites and found strategies are kept.
settings.cleanup.remove_service_hint: Removes the service and the WinDivert driver, restores the changed Windows settings. To bring it back, use “Turn on” on Home.
settings.cleanup.uninstall_helper_hint: The helper makes changes with administrator rights. Without it the app is view-only; at the first action you will be offered to install it again (one permission prompt).
settings.remove_service.confirm_service: Remove the optimization service and the WinDivert driver? Optimization will stay off until the next “Turn on”.
settings.remove_service.confirm_process: Remove the optimization service and the WinDivert driver? If optimization is on, it will turn off until the next “Turn on”.
